title: membrane-listen
description: SYNTHETIC sonification of a classical phase-oscillator model (not a recording, not a medical model): a sensor inside a simulated ring reads the local phase and the reading is rendered as audio; heart-like and brain-like scenes are pulse-arrival toys sonified as decaying thumps. Includes pre-registered, seeded studies with confidence intervals, including null and negative results. Not a medical device, not a diagnosis. No listening test was run; nothing here is a claim about perception or physiology.
notes: Synthetic simulation (classical software). Not a recording, not a medical model, not a medical device, not a diagnosis; nothing transfers to real physiology or perception.
